title: conductor error

code.description: the decision providers' refusals: the same as `type`

field.description: the field a refusal is about (`questions.classify.endpoint`)

confirm.description: 409 confirm_needed (a decision provider's destination outside the LAN, SEC-16): send the same request again with it

destination.description: 409 confirm_needed: the host outside the LAN

description: every 4xx body of the conductor's routes and the decision providers' (`/v1/fleet/decision-providers/*`); a refusal about one field names it in `field`, the providers' carry their `code` (the same as `type`), and a 409 confirm_needed its `confirm`, `destination` and `lan`
